title: Egypt, *an international edition.*
subtitle: A Founders Club retreat in Egypt between February and April 2027: three settings, with NOYA running the ground and the club keeping the room.

blocks.text: Egypt offers an international edition few destinations can match: Giza, the Red Sea and the Nile, within one country. The club keeps the members, the programme and the speakers; NOYA runs the venues, stays, movement and every detail on the ground.

items.title: The Giza summit
items.text: Three days in Cairo: sessions by day, a private evening facing the Pyramids, and the Grand Egyptian Museum before departure.

items.title: The Red Sea retreat
items.text: El Gouna for four days: sessions in the morning, the sea in the afternoon, members together in villas or one resort.
meta: Villas or resort, boats, dinners, wellness

items.title: The Nile mastermind
items.text: A small group between Luxor and Aswan: riverside hotels, a private Nile journey and conversations among the temples.

rows: International retreats and founder getaways are already part of the Founders Club year.
The opening of the Grand Egyptian Museum has given Cairo a new cultural landmark.

blocks.label: Next step
blocks.title: One call to choose the setting.
blocks.text: Agree the setting, the group size and dates between February and April 2027.
Venues, access and dates are subject to permits, approvals and availability. NOYA confirms each before anything is presented to a client.
